about: Every charge is taken from a receipt in email. Dates and times are Pacific time. Amounts are US dollars.

services.name: Claude
services.used_for: Builds the game: every session that writes code, dialogue, prompts and plans. Also runs the board's START tasks.

allows.text: Ten times the Pro plan's usage every week, with no five-hour limit on a verified account. Anthropic renamed Max 20x to Ultra and moved Max 20x subscribers over at the same price.
allows.source: support.claude.com, What is the Ultra plan?, read Nov 20

allows.text: Fable models are included. Up to half of the weekly limit can go to Fable at no extra cost.
allows.source: support.claude.com, Claude Fable models on your plan, read Nov 20

allows.text: $200 of Claude API credit each month, once a Claude Console organization is linked to the plan.
allows.source: platform.claude.com, API credits for Max, Ultra, and Team plans, read Nov 20

allows.text: Usage credits are extra usage bought in the app on top of the plan: 20 for $20.00, 100 for $90.00.
allows.source: Apple receipts of Oct 26 and Nov 4

services.keys: Signed in on your devices. The board's START tasks use task links saved as repo secrets.
services.balance_kind: Weekly usage limit. It is shown only inside Claude, so this page links to it.
gaps: Apple does not email a receipt when a subscription renews unless renewal receipts are switched on. The Pro renewals expected on Aug 30 and Sep 30 ($20.00 each) are not in the ledger.
Any usage credits bought on the web instead of the iPhone app would be billed by Anthropic directly. No such receipt was found.

services.name: Google AI (Gemini)
services.used_for: Gemini watches recordings of the game and writes the chapter audits. It also drafted prompts and the bestiary.

allows.text: Five times the Gemini usage limits of the Pro plan, 20 TB of storage and YouTube Premium.
allows.source: Tom's Guide on the $100 AI Ultra plan, read Nov 20
support.google.com, Google AI Ultra benefits, read Nov 20

services.keys: Signed in with your Google account. The game holds no Gemini key.
services.balance_kind: Usage limits inside Gemini. Not readable from here.
gaps: Google AI Pro renewed on Nov 13 ($19.99) one day before the move to Ultra. No refund email for the unused Pro days was found.
The August receipt is a renewal, so the first Google AI Plus charge is older than this ledger.

services.name: xAI API
services.used_for: Makes the game's pictures in the Art Library, the monster battle videos, and checks pictures and clips with a vision model.

allows.text: Pay per use from the credit bought. A 3 second monster video on the lite model costs about 8 cents.
allows.source: CLAUDE.md and claude/video-battle-plan.md in the repo

services.keys: Repo secret XAI_API_KEY for the Actions. The Art Library also keeps a key on each device.
gaps: Use before 2026-11-21 is only partly in the log: pictures made from the Art Library on a device key in the first weeks were not written anywhere. From that day every Action that spends on xAI (art-gen, clip-gen, clip-gate and its look checks) writes its run to the log.
A daily balance read needs a Management key and the team id as repo secrets (XAI_MANAGEMENT_KEY, XAI_TEAM_ID). Without them the figure here is the last balance recorded, less the use logged after it.

services.name: X Premium (Grok app)
services.used_for: Not used by the game's tools. Listed because it is an AI subscription on the same account.

plan.name: Premium
plan.price_note: First month was $15.00. It renews at $30.00.

allows.text: Not confirmed. The receipt names the plan and the price only.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.used_for: Every voice in the game and the music: the Voice Library, the Music Library and the voice-gen Action.

allows.text: 600,000 credits a month. One credit is about one character of speech. Unused credits roll over.
Pay-as-you-go credit can be bought on top. Each top-up unit cost $1.00.
The account's custom voice slots were full at 30 on Nov 2, under the earlier plan.

services.keys: Repo secret ELEVENLABS_API_KEY for the voice-gen and costs-sync Actions. The Voice and Music Library keep a key on each device.
services.balance_kind: Credits left this month, read once a day by the costs-sync job with the repo's ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.
gaps: Invoice UIRDNETR-0008 (between Oct 29 and Nov 3) has no receipt email. It may be a zero invoice or a missing charge.

services.name: fal.ai
services.used_for: Runs the Wan 3.0 video model for the family's battle animations (the wan-gen Action).

allows.text: Pay per use from the credit bought. Each job's price is estimated before it is sent.

services.keys: Repo secret FAL_KEY. The daily balance read needs an admin scope key: repo secret FAL_ADMIN_KEY (fal answers an API scope key with 401).

services.name: Sorceress
services.used_for: Used by hand on Nov 17 for the first Wan and Kling video tests. Replaced by fal.ai.

allows.text: A Wan clip cost 70 Sorceress credits, about 70 cents.

gaps: No Sorceress receipt was found in email. If credits were bought, that charge is missing from the ledger.

services.name: GitHub
services.used_for: Holds the game, publishes it to the web address and runs the Actions that call the paid services. Not an AI service itself.

allows.text: Not confirmed. No GitHub invoice was found in email, which fits the free plan.

services.keys: A token on each device for the board and libraries.
